result.topic_en: Euler says Lagrange's integration of dx/√X = dy/√Y belongs to the 'third way' of integration, by differentiation itself. He announces a fuller exposition, then begins checking that Lagrange's integral satisfies the differential equation by putting √X + √Y = V.
